entries.text: And it’s pretty obvious they’re not here to roll\nout a friendly welcome mat.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: common_1180_friend_18

entries.text: There’s no way we can handle this many![VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: common_1180_botan_01

entries.text: And don’t tell me...they’re all ancient Pokémon?![VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: common_1180_botan_02a

entries.text: And don’t tell me...they’re all future Pokémon?![VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: common_1180_botan_02b

entries.text: We’ve got a little disaster on our hands here...[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: common_1180_friend_00

entries.text: Look, even that fellow’s ready to bail...[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: common_1180_friend_01

entries.text: Then I guess it’s my turn! I’ve been waitin’![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_1180_rival_01

entries.text: Wow, they’re strong! Now THIS is a\nworthwhile challenge![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_1180_rival_03

entries.text: I’m glad you’re on our side, but you’re still\nREALLY annoying when you say stuff like that![VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: common_1180_botan_03

entries.text: Gyah! Why’re they coming at ME?![VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: common_1180_botan_04

entries.text: Guh. The ancient past must’ve been terrifying...[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: common_1180_botan_06a

entries.text: Guh. The future must be terrifying...[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: common_1180_botan_06b

entries.text: If those Pokémon get out, we’re gonna have\na gigantic mess on our hands!\c\nWe gotta go after ’em, Penny![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_1180_rival_05

entries.text: Gah! Hold on, Nemona—and why do I get the\nfeeling you’re enjoying all this?![VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: common_1180_botan_10

entries.text: I hope the two of them can handle their part...[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: common_1180_friend_02

entries.text: But at least the crowd’s been thinned out now.\nGuess it’s up to us to deal with what’s left![VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: common_1180_friend_03

entries.text: Let’s go for this strong-looking one first![VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: common_1180_friend_04

entries.text: See! The power of friendship had us perfectly\nin sync! All thanks to our Titan hunting together![VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: common_1180_friend_05

entries.text: Still scared, huh? You worried you might have to\nface that other one of your kind?[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: common_1180_friend_06

entries.text: Well then, lemme take on some of the burden![VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: common_1180_friend_07

entries.text: These stragglers should be nothing! Me and\nMabosstiff here can take them![VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: common_1180_friend_08

entries.text: Heheh, glad to see you’ve got some faith in us\nat last!\c\nMabosstiff can’t wait to battle, either![VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: common_1180_friend_10

entries.text: Aw, come on! If you’re not even gonna rely on\nyour friends, then who are you going to rely on?\r\nMabosstiff here is raring to go! Leave this to us![VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: common_1180_friend_11

entries.text: You really ruined my whole childhood, you know.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: common_1180_friend_13

entries.text: But it’s not like seeing you cowering and scared\noutta your wits makes me feel any better about it.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: common_1180_friend_14

entries.text: You’ve got amazing powers, if you just use ’em!\nAnd you’ve got us, too! So... So...\c\nSo don’t you even think about losing to that jerk![VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: common_1180_friend_15
